news.headline: A TikTok video hit 340K views — the 48h FYP momentum window closes tonight
news.detail: The FYP algorithm picked up an Easi Breezi video on May 25. The top objection in comments is fear that the magnet attachment hole lets bugs/wasps in. Multiple other videos pulling 30–50K views ask basic 'what does it do' questions.
news.opportunity: Post a follow-up reel today (same bug/smog/before-after format) addressing the wasp objection directly — tiny rear-facing port, air forced out when the tube is clipped, 2 years of multi-country testing with zero ingress. Bank the reach while it's hot.

news.headline: Zyon air-purifying helmet ships Q3 2026 at €720, plans to license its filtration tech
news.detail: Zyon (Madrid) confirms Q3 2026 delivery at €720 pre-order (~$780, rising to €799). Four-layer filter (water-repellent + HEPA + activated carbon + fiber), claims 80%+ pollutant blocking, and plans to license its tech to other helmet makers — explicitly targeting polluted Asian markets.
news.opportunity: Wedge: 5.7× cheaper ($136 vs ~$780), modular, fits any helmet, ships now. Pitch MCN/Visordown/T3 to ride their press cycle. Hook: 'Zyon is $780 shipping Q3. Do the same for $136 on the helmet you own today.'

news.headline: Bangkok and Vientiane choke as dry-season haze pushes PM2.5 beyond health limits
news.detail: Transboundary biomass-burning haze is hammering mainland SE Asia. A Hanoi study confirms motorcyclists get the highest black-carbon exposure of any commuter group — directly Easi Breezi's core use case.
news.opportunity: Time AQI-spike content to the haze: Bali/SE-Asia ride-along in real smog + the 'motorcyclists breathe the most black carbon' stat. Feeds both TikTok reach and the 'helmet vs air purifier' FAQ-page SEO gap.

landscape: Zyon's Q3 2026 deliveries + tech-licensing plans validate the category and signal it's heating up — but at €720 they're a luxury whole-helmet play. Our wedge holds: modular, 5.7× cheaper, fits any helmet, ships now, real HEPA H11. The bigger story today is owned demand: a 340K-view TikTok with a live FYP window is worth more than any discount, and SE Asia haze season is a direct tailwind. The constraint has flipped from traffic to conversion — visits are up 24–54% but CVR is still 0 over 16 days. Priority order: post the TikTok follow-up reel, fire the EB20 Brevo blast (52 sends, 0 cost), then convert the rising organic search traffic with an FAQ page.
